extraction.Name: Claude Sully
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 5, 1918, by Frank Sully
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged multiple times; mortgage foreclosed and sheriff executed a deed to the Rock Island Savings Bank
extraction.Buyer: Rock Island Savings Bank (via sheriff's deed executed September 25, 1923, after $5000 mortgage foreclosed September 16, 1922)
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612782 issued December 29, 1917. Receipt for patent signed by allottee February 11, 1918. In 1915 Joe Kirby filed a Lis pendens against the land but it was released the same year. On August 19, 1918, Sully mortgaged the land to the Tripp County State Bank for $500; mortgage released May 15, 1919. On April 30, 1919, Sully mortgaged the land to Alla Smith for $2000. On March 25, 1920, he mortgaged the land to Alla Smith for $5000. On September 16, 1922, the $5000 mortgage was foreclosed after having been assigned to the Rock Island Savings Bank. On September 25, 1923, the sheriff executed a deed to the Rock Island Savings Bank. The Sullys had instituted a lawsuit to obtain their allotments. Land: Northwest quarter section 28, township 99, range 74.
